title: All Expedition 33 Enemy Weaknesses - Full Element Chart
description: A complete table of every enemy weakness and resistance in Expedition 33, including Volester, Ballet, Chevaliere variants and boss adds.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: A complete elemental affinity chart for the standard enemies of Expedition 33. Use it to check what a given enemy is weak to, what it resists, and whether anything is absorbed - absorbing an element means your attack heals it, which is the single most common way to lose a fight you should have won.

sections.title: Notable Entries
sections.content:
Volester

Weak to Ice, no resistances. One of the simplest enemies to counter - just bring Ice and it folds.

The Chevaliere family works differently per variant

  • Steel Chevaliere - weak to Physical, resists nothing
  • Gold Chevaliere - weak to Light and Dark, resists Fire and Ice
  • Ceramic Chevaliere - weak to six elements at once (Fire, Ice, Lightning, Earth, Dark, Light), which makes it the most permissive target in the game

Watch the Earth absorbers

Gault, Glaise and Pelerin all absorb an element while being weak to Fire or Ice. Attacking with the wrong type is worse than doing nothing.

sections.title: How to Use This Table
sections.content:
• Check before swapping weapons. Weapon damage type determines far more than raw attack power against these enemies
  • Never attack an absorber. The Absorbs column is the one that loses fights
  • Bosses are listed separately - see the boss guide and the boss order pages for boss-specific resistances
